verdict.rationale: Docusign can be driven headlessly through its eSignature REST API, an official Node.js client library, and published OpenAPI specs used to generate SDKs. An official MCP server is also documented, and Docusign shows agreement automation from the terminal by pairing Gemini CLI with Docusign MCP. Hands-on community reports describe building production API integrations quickly. Missing for 10: no first-party CLI, no documented CI/CD pipeline usage or examples, no evidence of non-interactive auth (e.g., service-account/JWT) for unattended runs, and probes found no OpenAPI or llms.txt at standard developer-site paths.
